mapper.select: select * from cc_task_attempt where company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and attempt_id=#{attemptId} for update
select id from cc_company where id=#{companyId} and status=1 for update

select count(*) from cc_task_contact c join cc_task_config t on t.id=c.task_id where t.company_id=#{companyId} and t.id=#{taskId} and c.call_status in ('pending','retry','dialing','ringing','answered')

select (select count(*) from cc_task_attempt where company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and state='claimed' and call_id is not null) as active_calls, (select count(*) from cc_task_attempt a join cc_task_config t on t.id=a.task_id where a.company_id=#{companyId} and t.company_id=#{companyId} and t.transfer_type=#{transferType} and t.transfer_id=#{transferId} and a.state='claimed' and a.call_id is not null) as target_active_calls, (select count(*) from cc_task_attempt where company_id=#{companyId} and state='claimed' and call_id is not null) as company_active_calls, count(*) as completed_calls, coalesce(sum(case when l.answer_flag in (0,3) then 1 else 0 end),0) as answered_calls, coalesce(sum(case when l.answer_flag=3 then 1 else 0 end),0) as abandoned_calls from cc_task_attempt a join cc_call_log l on l.call_id=a.call_id and l.company_id=a.company_id and l.task_id=a.task_id where a.company_id=#{companyId} and a.task_id=#{taskId} and a.state='completed' and a.cts >= #{since}

select p.* from cc_company_phone p join cc_company_phone_group g on g.phone_id=p.id join cc_company_display d on d.id=g.display_id where d.id=#{poolId} and d.company_id=#{companyId} and g.company_id=#{companyId} and d.status=1 and p.company_id=#{companyId} and p.status=2 and p.type in (2,3) order by p.id
select * from cc_call_log where company_id=#{companyId} and task_id=#{taskId} and call_id=#{callId}
select * from cc_call_device where company_id=#{companyId} and call_id=#{callId} and device_type=2 order by id limit 1
